name: Opendemic: Anonymous COVID-19 Proximity Alerts
content: Problems and Purpose Given concerns about a lack of data due to inadequate testing, David Hachuel and his business partner developed their new Opendemic application to crowdsource information on potential and confirmed COVID-19 cases. As such, users can better inform their own decisions about social distancing. Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection The application is open to all interested in downloading it and/or participating information.
